# ENV Variable Inventory — Project Nyra (No values)

This is a **master inventory** of environment variables you may need across the stack.
Do NOT store secrets here; store them in Infisical using your path taxonomy.

## Router / Gateway
- NEXUS_HOST
- NEXUS_PORT
- NEXUS_PUBLIC_URL
- NEXUS_LOG_LEVEL

- ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
- ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
- GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY
- GOOGLE_API_KEY (alias)
- OPENAI_API_KEY (optional/provider)
- AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY (optional)
- AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT (optional)
